directBlueVideoLead.title: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon: Blue Rescue Team (DS) Opening / Intro
directBlueVideoLead.author: Pokemon Dungeon
directBlueVideoLead.inspectionRequested: Compare aerial shot at +4 seconds and +5.8 seconds; check whether cyan sky and blue water stay daytime rather than turning orange.

secondaryEditionDifferenceLead.claim: The Red aerial scene shifts to sunset, whereas Blue stays daytime.
secondaryEditionDifferenceLead.status: Its edition distinction agrees with the direct Blue manual video observation; runtime selection is grounded in the observed footage.

runtimeDecision: Keep the current daytime palette. Do not select the comparative Red sunset cycle for the Blue opening.
validation: Pure asset bytes parsed without importing or executing game source; no ROM read, downloaded or built.

directBlueObservation.method: Manual inspection in the normal public browser video player by the root reviewer.
observations: At 0:24 and 0:25 the aerial sky and water remain cyan/blue and the forest remains green.
At 0:27 the white fade begins while the sky remains blue and the letter is in the foreground.
directBlueObservation.supports: Blue retains the daytime palette rather than applying the Red sunset cycle.
directBlueObservation.limitations: Compressed, horizontally stretched footage supports the visible edition distinction, not pixel equality, exact palette channels, margins or frame timing.

timingQualification: The video cinematic begins around 0:07 after logos and reaches its white fade around 0:27. Exact scene-start and fade boundaries were not frame-counted; the existing 19-second boundary remains qualified.
